name: Fireside Nights at Fruit and Spice Park
when_note: Saturdays, November 28 to December 26, 6 to 10 PM
cost: Adults $10, kids 6 to 11 $5, ages 5 and under free
paras: Fruit and Spice Park lists Fireside Nights on five Saturday evenings in 2026: November 28 and December 5, 12, 19 and 26, each from 6 to 10 PM.
The park describes its garden turning into a holiday wonderland, with guests invited to bring blankets and lawn chairs, sip hot cocoa, eat cookies and take holiday photos.
A first come, first served Nocturnal Tour of the Garden is part of the evening.

Admission is $10 for ages 12 and up, $5 for ages 6 to 11 and free for ages 5 and under, bought at the door or in advance online. Pets are not allowed, and complimentary passes and coupons are not accepted for this event.

name: Merry in Mizner Meet and Greet with Surf's Up Santa
host: City of Boca Raton Recreation Services
venue: Downtown Boca Adirondack Chair, Mizner Park
address: Federal Highway and Mizner Boulevard, Boca Raton, FL 33432
paras: The City of Boca Raton lists a Merry in Mizner Meet and Greet with Surf's Up Santa on Tuesday, December 8, 2026 from 6 to 8 PM at Mizner Park.

Santa trades his snow boots for flip-flops, and the city says to stop by the giant Downtown Boca Adirondack chair for a family photo with a Florida-style Santa in a festive Hawaiian shirt and board shorts.
The listing is part of the city's Merry in Mizner series, which Recreation Services publishes on its Community Events pages.

name: Merry in Mizner Stuff-A-Plush
address: Federal Highway and Mizner Boulevard, Boca Raton, FL 33432
paras: Boca Raton lists Merry in Mizner's Stuff-A-Plush on Tuesday, December 15, 2026 at 6 PM at the Mizner Park South Gazebo.
Kids and families make their own plush winter critter. The city lists the activity as free, limited to the first 200 attendees on a first come, first served basis.
It is one of several December Merry in Mizner events on the city calendar.
